svg.aria-label: Induction cooktop cross-section: a flat coil under a glass plate carries high-frequency current; its alternating flux passes up through the steel pan base and induces eddy currents in a thin skin that heat the pan directly
svg.text: The induction cooktop: the pan is the secondary, and its own resistance is the load

text.tspan: Induction cooktop — a transformer whose one-turn secondary is the pan base
